Computer Diagnostic.description: Deposit taken at check-in on every computer. Applies to the repair when the customer proceeds.

Priority Service (Computer).description: Front of the queue plus a diagnostic answer within one business day. Never same day.

Shop Labor.description: One-hour minimum. Use when the work is not covered by an existing billing code. Get the estimate approved before starting, then bill in 30-minute increments.

Corrected During Diagnostics (Computer).description: Fault found and fixed inside the diagnostic, with no part and no deeper disassembly. The deposit is already on the invoice as a negative, so this line zeroes it out.

Declined Repair.description: Used when the customer declines the recommended repair. The deposit is already on the invoice as a negative, so this line zeroes it out.

No Issue Found (Computer).description: Used when no fault is found or the reported issue cannot be reproduced during testing. The deposit is already on the invoice as a negative, so this line zeroes it out.

Data Transfer.description: Transfer customer data to a computer or supported external storage device. Its own line whenever there is data to move.

Clone to Different Hardware.description: Clone an existing drive for use with different computer hardware.

Hard Drive Clone.description: Clone an existing drive as part of a storage upgrade or computer repair. The drive is included and is not also billed as a Simple Part Install.

New Computer Setup.description: Set up a new computer and complete the standard initial configuration. Included with a computer bought here.

Operating System Clean Install.description: Perform a clean installation of the supported operating system. Use this instead of the cleanup when the OS is too damaged to clean, never both.

Password Removal.description: Remove or reset a supported local account password when ownership can be verified.

Thermal Service.description: Internal cleaning and replacement of applicable thermal paste or thermal materials.

Tune-Up.description: Standard software optimization and maintenance service.

Virus, Malware, or Scam Cleanup.description: Viruses, malware, adware and PUPs, remote-access and tech-support scam cleanup, browser reset, security check, verification scan.

In-Shop Consultation (30 mins to 1 hour).description: Sit-down time with a technician to review options, plan a purchase, or get a second opinion. Quoted before the tech sits down. Never credited toward a repair.

Insurance Quote.description: Prepare a written repair or replacement estimate for an insurance claim.

Game Console Diagnostic.description: Deposit taken at check-in on every console. Applies to the repair when the customer proceeds.

Full Internal Cleaning.description: Includes disassembling the console, cleaning the internal components, fans, and heatsinks, and replacing the thermal paste as applicable. PlayStation 5 liquid metal and Nintendo Switch devices are excluded.

PS5 Liquid Metal Cleaning.description: Full teardown, removal of the old liquid metal, and reapplication. PlayStation 5 only.

Priority Service.description: Front of the queue plus a diagnostic answer within one business day. Never same day.
